blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five V196 main views and six pose renders shows the overskirt remains covered in dense, sharp triangular fragments and folds instead of reading as a coherent sewn pleated surface. The lower self-collision distance materially reduced, but did not resolve, the visible breakup. The V196 native cloth geometry audit still records 2,967 inverted skirt source-fan triangles of 20,701 (14.3%); this is prototype instability evidence, not acceptance.

Direct V196 crouch and sit renders show the lap pulled away/fragmented, with substantial anterior thigh exposure; the side views show long detached-looking strips extending from the hem. The pose diagnostic independently reports only 31.4–39.8% sampled overskirt coverage on each upper thigh and 21.9–25.9% front-lap ray coverage in these poses. These geometric samples are diagnostics, not fit or visual acceptance.
The V196 front, side, and three-quarter renders still show angular, faceted jacket surface artifacts around the torso and an uneven waist transition.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
